title: Add reconciliation summary for simulated target allocation
body:
### Motivation

- Section C of the dashboard previously only listed per-analyzed-stock columns (`Current Executed Weight`, `Simulated Target Weight`, `Simulated Delta Amount`) and did not explain why simulated targets may sum to <100%.
- Users could not tell whether the missing weight was cash, unmanaged (non-analyzed) holdings, or a small rounding/residual, so the report lacked a portfolio-level reconciliation closure.

### Description

- Add a minimal reconciliation block builder `_build_section_c_reconciliation_lines(...)` in `src/notification.py` that computes `analyzed_target_weight_sum`, `unmanaged_holdings_weight`, an implied `target_cash_weight`, and a `residual`, and emits a closure equation and rounding/tolerance note.
- Integrate the reconciliation block into the dashboard `Section C` immediately after the simulated target allocation table without changing any execution, position manager, or accounting logic.
- Update tests in `tests/test_notification_summary_format.py` to assert presence and values of the reconciliation summary and adjust snapshot expectations to include the new block.

### Testing

- Ran `pytest -q tests/test_notification_summary_format.py` which executed the updated cases and reported `37 passed`.
- Added `test_section_c_reconciliation_explains_cash_unmanaged_and_residual` to cover: account with unmanaged holdings, account cash, `target_weight` sum < 100%, and presence of cash/unmanaged/residual reconciliation explanation in Section C.

------
